text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Teio Sho is the second race of Smart Falcon's promising winning streak. On the day of the race, the stands are humming with talk of her performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's also gained the admiration of her younger classmates running against her, many of whom come to greet her before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's efforts to raise the stock of dirt races are for her younger classmates' sake as well. She wants to create a world where people want to take on dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon heads into the race with that ambition in her heart.
